text: Election of the Chair of the Interview Subcommittee for Toronto Public Library Board under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix AII, for a term of office ending November 30, 2018, and until a successor is appointed.

The Interview Subcommittee for Toronto Public Library Board: 1. Elected Councillor Ford as Chair of the Interview Subcommittee for Toronto Public Library Board for a term of office ending November 30, 2018, and until a successor is appointed.
